Challenges

A fresh reason to drive another lap.

When progress slows

Support challenges offer focused goals: win, complete a clean lap or reach a DRIFT target. Follow the offered car, track and target shown in TURN.

PATROL

A temporary drive in the POLICE CAR on MIDNIGHT CITY. Finish a valid lap, with an optional second lap before returning Home. It previews content without granting the permanent unlock.

EXCURSION

The MONSTER TRUCK visits MOUNTAIN after the first procedural challenge. As with PATROL, a valid lap completes the preview; unfinished attempts can be retried.

Permanent goals

Achievements are the lasting checklist. Trophy Road turns their trophies into cars, track tiers, perks and mechanics.
